learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore how water gives life to our wondrous planet, how it travels through the magical water cycle, and why we must protect every single drop!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Water is the magic potion that keeps plants, animals, and humans alive. Our bodies use water to stay cool, digest food, and grow strong and healthy!
Our beautiful Earth has oceans, rivers, lakes, and underground wells. Rain and melting snow fill up these sources so we always have fresh water to drink and use.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌍 The Magic of the Water Cycle
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Water never stays in one place! The sun heats water so it turns into invisible vapor, then it cools into fluffy clouds, and finally falls back down to Earth as rain or snow.
Even though there is a lot of water on Earth, only a tiny bit is fresh and safe for drinking. We must be Earth Heroes by fixing leaky taps and turning off the water while brushing our teeth!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Be a Rainmaker Mini Experiment!
fun_activity.instructions: Place a small empty cup inside a large bowl, pour some warm water into the bowl around the cup, cover the bowl tightly with clear plastic wrap, and put a tiny pebble on top. Wait and watch how water drops form and fall into the cup just like real rain!

quick_recap: ⭐ Water is an essential gift of nature that all living beings need to survive and thrive.
⭐ The water cycle keeps water moving endlessly through evaporation, condensation, and precipitation.
⭐ Clean, fresh water is very limited, so saving water everyday is our most important duty.
